title: CBOR Protocol
content:
For high-performance, binary-optimized APIs, Photon supports CBOR (Concise Binary Object Representation). This is ideal for IoT devices or microservices where payload size is critical.

Using CBOR

Photon can handle CBOR by utilizing standard JS Blob transformation or specialized middleware:

import { cbor } from '@gravito/photon/cbor' // Optional optimization bundle

app.get('/binary-api', (c) => {
  const data = { id: 1, message: 'Lightweight binary data' }
  // Automatically sets application/cbor header
  return c.cbor(data)
})

Manual Handling

You can also handle it manually using any CBOR library (like cbor-x):

import { encode } from 'cbor-x'

app.get('/manual-cbor', (c) => {
  const payload = encode({ status: 'AOK' })
  return c.body(payload, 200, {
    'Content-Type': 'application/cbor'
  })
})
